# Technical Infrastructure

This folder covers the systemic connections, data mappings, and technical linkages that allow clinical information to flow from regional electronic patient journals (EPJ) into national registries. It documents how localized configuration gaps, such as missing mappings between specific clinical activities and standardized procedure codes in regional EPJ systems like NordEPJ, can directly impair the automated data harvesting and completeness of national clinical quality databases like the Akut Kirurgi Databasen (AKDB).

## Pages

- [[technical-infrastructure|Technical Infrastructure]] — Details the systemic data mappings between regional electronic patient journals and national registries, highlighting a specific configuration failure in NordEPJ that prevents the harvesting of nutrition plan data for the AKDB.
